name: Unistreet LaunchpadFactoryAuto forwards caller calldata to the V4 PositionManager
summary: LaunchpadFactoryAuto.launch() passes the caller's initCalldata and modifyCalldata unchecked into Uniswap V4 PositionManager.multicall() with the factory as msg.sender, and the factory custodies every launch's LP position NFT. The attacker launched a throwaway token with modifyCalldata = setApprovalForAll(attackContract, true), then burned each custodied position through modifyLiquidities and took the pooled USDC, WETH and launch tokens.
notes: Campaign: copycats emptied the factory's remaining eight positions and the four of sibling factory 0xd5799fd8 (same deployer, same launch()) 81 blocks later (0xfc3facd6), and the three of the deployer's earlier unverified factory 0x282ab97b in 0xa8a727b7 (0x41a1d3ec), each through an injected setApprovalForAll on the PositionManager.
Loss is the V4 PoolManager's outflow for the burned positions (loss.mjs); about 20 launch memecoins without a DefiLlama price are left out (rule 12).
